pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: sim/rubric.toml:119 A model judges a 20-second dead-air threshold, though transcript timestamps make it mechanically checkable (the runner already records max_say_gap_s and the sandbox gates it), so the property carries judge drift and cost it never needed.

techniques.evidence: sim/rubric.toml:119 A checklist could hold this (timestamps). Likewise addresses_viewer_by_name_or_rank (line 107) is checkable against the known viewer names and rank titles. Both are on the judge side.

sim/matrices/night.toml:12 Comparability is claimed from a shared tier alias. The judge is from the same model family as every core, and there is no disinterested-family judge, panel or anchor-set drift check.
sim/matrices/rate-cap-exemptions.toml:11 The treatment/control A/B lists five metrics to compare and declares no optimized metric, thresholds or advance rule before the run.
sim/rubric.toml:5 The rubric is a versioned part of the instrument, and series are never spliced across it.
sim/rubric.toml:9 Safety rules use the all-of-N bar that unattended live operation needs. Quality rates never gate.
sim/matrices/roastmaster-vs-theatrical.toml:3 Overlapping intervals are treated as no order, and a dedicated comparison is scheduled instead of ranking.
sim/matrices/night-opus.toml:2 A judge change is marked as a discontinuity, not spliced into night.toml's series.
sim/matrices/rate-cap-exemptions-control.toml:4 Both arms have the same N, the same seeds and the same day's instrument. No best-of-N is taken.
sim/matrices/pilot.toml:1 Cadence is tiered (pilot, night, heavy) and every matrix declares a concurrency cap.
sim/matrices/rate-cap-exemptions.toml:4 The treatment is a pre-filter the harness applies, not a capability the candidate can decline.
sim/matrices/heavy.toml:2 A full cross-product scored absolutely. There is no pairwise schedule.

pairs.evidence: apps/console/fidelity/run.mjs:1 This context gates deterministic console code: a style-contract and texture comparison against a captured prototype, DOM and RPC counts at a 10x fixture, and bundle byte budgets. No non-deterministic system is scored. A search of apps/console/budgets, apps/console/fidelity and apps/console/src/perf for rubric, temperature, trials, judge_tier and pass_rate found nothing, so the subject belongs to test-harness here.
